_comment: Section 8 of BIFM_UT_POC_Understanding_Document_v1.0 — pre-validation flags generated at ingestion, surfacing likely AWD rejection causes BEFORE the instruction reaches the authoriser. These are distinct from app/validation/engine.py: that module checks field-level data quality (format/completeness of a single field); this module checks document-level completeness signals that BIFM's authorisers actually reject instructions for.

flags.label: Page initials missing
flags.trigger_condition: Bottom-left 'Initial' field appears blank on any page of the form

flags.label: Investor signature absent
flags.trigger_condition: Declaration page signature field appears blank

flags.label: Banking details incomplete
flags.trigger_condition: One or more mandatory banking fields blank when the transaction requires banking info

flags.label: Fund selection missing
flags.trigger_condition: No fund selected and no amount populated

flags.label: KYC document absent
flags.trigger_condition: Required KYC checkboxes unticked and no KYC supporting document detected in this batch

flags.label: KYC contact info or signature missing
flags.trigger_condition: KYC document present in the batch but contact number, email, or signatory name was not captured off it

flags.label: ID document not detected
flags.trigger_condition: No identity document found as an attachment to the submission

flags.label: Beneficiary section blank
flags.trigger_condition: New Business only — beneficiary completion is compulsory

flags.label: Beneficiary % ≠ 100%
flags.trigger_condition: Beneficiary portions filled but do not sum to 100%

flags.label: Debit fields incomplete
flags.trigger_condition: Debit option selected but commencement date / escalation rate not populated

flags.label: 7-day debit notice
flags.trigger_condition: Debit change/cancellation date within 7 days of the regular collection date — effective next month instead

flags.label: GSGF quarterly cut-off
flags.trigger_condition: GSGF form received — quarterly deadline applies, not the daily cut-off

flags.label: Third-party bank — Form B absent
flags.trigger_condition: Third-party payment selected but Form B (banking annex) not present in the submission

flags.label: Acting on Behalf — Form C absent
flags.trigger_condition: Account type 'Acting on Behalf' or 'Joint' but Form C (minor/joint annex) not present

flags.label: Funds receipt flag (ADD only)
flags.trigger_condition: Additional Investment received — e-stamp / proof of funds receipt required before processing can proceed

flags.label: Tax section unanswered
flags.trigger_condition: New Business only — all three FATCA/CRS Yes/No questions left blank
